grammar.summary: 本课学习 with 复合结构与表"覆盖"的 be covered with。

points.title: with + 名词 + V-ing/过去分词 复合结构
points.explanation: with the water above pressing down 伴随状语。with 复合结构可替换独立主格，正式度稍低。

examples.en: With the continents super-imposed upon it, the sea floor is the basic form.
examples.cn: 把大陆叠加在上面，海底就是地壳的基本形态。

points.title: be covered with 表覆盖
points.explanation: covered with sediment = 覆盖着沉积物。表状态：be covered in/with 均可。

examples.en: The sea floor is covered with ooze.
